description: main has no required status checks, so platformAutomerge stays false and Renovate waits for PR checks before merging.
Non-breaking updates merge once PR checks pass, except brush-parser. A breaking update merges on its own only when the PR's checks run what it changes; the rest wait for review.

packageRules.description: Group and automerge non-major dependency updates after checks pass.
Renovate calls a cargo 0.x minor bump minor, but cargo versioning marks it breaking; review breaking updates in their own PR. Pin and digest updates carry no breaking flag, so they stay routine.

A 0.x crate's compatible patch and breaking minor share one update bucket, so a pending breaking minor would hide the patch. This must not match on update type, because the bucket is chosen before the update type exists.

CI runs every action, runner, and CI tool on the PR itself, so their majors merge once checks pass. cargo-mutants only gets a smoke run, because a workflow-only diff has no mutants. create-github-app-token runs only on a tag push, which no PR exercises.
With warnings denied, a new Clippy or linter release can fail CI. Keep these updates out of the routine group so a failure blocks only them.
Shell parse trees decide which commands are counted; review parser upgrades separately.

customManagers.description: Cargo tools that install-action installs at a pinned version.
actionlint, built with go install at a pinned version.
The cargo manager leaves rust-version alone. Without this manager, a toolchain bump would leave the MSRV behind rust-toolchain.toml.
